biography: Njoya Studios is a multidisciplinary creative practice producing physical worlds through colour, material, movement and storytelling. Every project begins with a foundation of built visual language to craft an immersive aesthetic and emotional representation of a place. The studio specializes in creative direction, spatial and environmental design, commercial and editorial design, and cultural spaces. Founder and director Ibby Njoya is represented by New School Represents.

team.name: Luiza Chara
team.description: Luiza collaborates closely with the studio director to bring creative visions to life. She leads projects through design research and project management, supporting the team in visual exploration and execution to ensure each project aligns with the studio’s goals and standards.

team.name: Aisha Ahamed
team.description: Aisha provides high-level administrative support, managing the directors schedule, communications and logistics whilst aiding across all projects with design research and visual exploration.

team.name: Kwok Hei Yung
team.description: Yung transforms the studios conceptual designs into 3D renders across all projects, bringing the studios ideas to life.
